result.summary: Found 1 issue: a nonsensical '-0%' discount badge on the pizza card that looks like a broken calculation/placeholder.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second card under 'Popular right now' (pizza image) displays '-0%', which is a nonsensical negative-zero discount and looks like a broken placeholder or calculation bug.
issues.suggestion: Fix the discount calculation/formatting so it shows the correct discount (e.g. '-10%'), and hide the badge entirely when the discount is 0%.
